prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 40-year-old woman with a straight black bob and softly square face carefully unwraps her framed abstract painting for her first solo exhibition in a small gallery. A 33-year-old fair-haired assistant steadies the opposite frame edge. The artwork contains only broad abstract colour shapes, no letters or identifiable figures. Use gallery daylight, plain walls and believable separate hands, frame and protective wrapping. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.
Native image aspect ratio exactly 4:5. One physical rectangular frame with four consistent corners and straight edges; the two people support separate opposite sides while removing paper wrapping. The framed painting has broad plain abstract colour shapes only, without any words or signatures.
review: Vertical first-exhibition scene shows two women unwrapping one framed abstract painting. Artist peels real kraft paper while assistant supports the opposite frame edge with separate visible hands. Frame perspective and corners are coherent, faces are distinct, artwork has broad colour shapes with no text or signature. Lower paper, bubble wrap and table are physically continuous.
